label: Files
summary: File, directory, archive, and transfer helper functions.
must_follow: Look up exact signatures before using file or transfer helpers.
Treat path, FTP, and archive operations as side-effectful and handle errors explicitly.
avoid: Do not assume missing files or remote paths fail silently.
Do not invent overloads for transfer helpers.

elements.name: Directory
elements.summary: Retrieves filesystem entries that match a path or wildcard pattern, with optional filtering for directories, hidden entries, and system entries.

elements.name: CombineFiles
elements.summary: Concatenates multiple files into one output file on disk.

elements.name: CreateZip
elements.summary: Creates a ZIP archive from a source directory.

elements.name: ExtractZip
elements.summary: Extracts a ZIP archive into a target directory.

elements.name: CopyToFtp
elements.summary: Appends the same text content to one or more files on an FTP or SFTP server.

elements.name: DeleteFromFtp
elements.summary: Deletes a remote file through FTP, or through SFTP when bIsSFTP is .T..

elements.name: CheckOnFtp
elements.summary: Checks whether a remote file exists on an FTP server, or on an SFTP server when bIsSFTP is .T..

elements.name: FtpsClient
elements.summary: Transfers files and manages directories on an FTPS server.
